class.name: OcgStandardArraystreambuffer
class.brief_description: Custom buffer object implementing STL interface std::streambuf for streamed reading from allocated memory block. Implements minimal sub-set of methods for passing buffer to std::istream, including seek support.

method.name: from_char_const_ptr_int
method.description: Main constructor. Passed pointer is stored as is (memory is NOT copied nor released with destructor).

method.name: Init
method.description: (Re)-initialize the stream. Passed pointer is stored as is (memory is NOT copied nor released with destructor).
